About.metaDescription: Founded on faith, built on community, and dedicated to the spiritual growth of Broward County.
About.heroAlt: Interior of a modern church sanctuary with warm light streaming through windows and rows of wooden pews in a peaceful atmosphere
About.heroBody: Founded on faith, built on community, and dedicated to the spiritual growth of Broward County.
About.storyHeading: A Heart for Broward, A Soul for Service
About.storyP1: Bethel Casa De Dios began as a small gathering of families in a living room, united by a shared hunger for authentic worship and a deep-seated love for our neighbors in Broward County.
About.storyP2: Over the years, we have grown into a multi-generational community committed to a clear mission: to evangelize, disciple, affirm, and send.
About.storyP3: We evangelize by sharing the message of hope with our community. We disciple by helping people grow in their faith through teaching and connection. We affirm by creating a welcoming environment where every person is valued and loved. And we send by equipping individuals to live out their purpose beyond the walls of the church.
About.storyP4: We believe that every person who walks through our doors is not just a guest, but a valued member of a family ready to welcome them home.
About.storyImageAlt: Diverse group of community members laughing and sharing a meal at a long wooden table in a sunlit hall
About.storyQuote: “Where every soul finds a place to rest.”
About.valuesBody: The pillars that sustain our community and guide our path forward.
About.valueBiblicalBody: Unwavering commitment to the Word as our compass for life and leadership.
About.valueCommunityBody: Breaking bread and sharing lives beyond the Sunday service. We believe in being known and being loved.
About.valueGenerosityBody: Giving our time, talents, and resources to bless others.
About.valueWorshipBody: Creating a sacred space where the Holy Spirit can move freely and hearts can be transformed.
About.valueHospitalityBody: Welcoming every person with the same grace and warmth that Christ extended to us.
About.leadershipBody: The shepherds of our flock, committed to serving our congregation with humility and wisdom.
About.leadPastorsImageAlt: A warm, smiling mature couple standing together in a garden, dressed in professional yet approachable attire
About.leadPastorsBody: Pastors David and Elena have served Bethel Casa De Dios for over 15 years. With a passion for teaching the Word and a heart for marriage ministry, they lead our community with a vision to see every family in Broward flourish spiritually and emotionally.
About.ctaBody: We would love to meet you this Sunday and help you find your place in our story.

Give.metaDescription: Online, Zelle, and serving — multiple ways to support the mission of Bethel Casa De Dios.
Give.heroQuote: “Each of you should give what you have decided in your heart to give, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.” — 2 Corinthians 9:7
Give.onlineBody: Simple and secure one-time or recurring donations using your debit or credit card.
Give.zelleBody: Give directly from your bank account without any processing fees. 100% of your contribution goes to the church.
Give.zelleStep1: Open your banking app and select Zelle.
Give.zelleStep3: Confirm the name “Bethel Casa De Dios” appears.
Give.zelleNote: Please include your full name in the memo field for tax purposes.
Give.volunteersAlt: A diverse group of church volunteers smiling and working together in a community garden setting with soft natural morning light
Give.servingBadge: WE ARE ALWAYS LOOKING FOR HELP
Give.servingBody: Generosity isn't just about finances. Giving your time and talents is a profound way to serve the body of Christ. From hospitality to tech, we have a place for you.
Give.trustTaxBody: Bethel Casa De Dios is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. Your contributions are tax-deductible.
Give.trustTransparencyBody: We provide quarterly impact reports and annual giving statements to all regular contributors.
Give.trustImpactBody: 10% of every dollar given is dedicated to local community outreach and global mission work.
Give.ctaBody: If you have questions about your donation, need to update your recurring gift, or want to give through stock or physical assets, our finance team is here to help.

Visit.metaDescription: First-time visitor guide for Bethel Casa De Dios — what to expect, kids ministry, parking, language, and more.
Visit.heroHeading: New Here? We'd Love to Meet You
Visit.heroBody: Walking into a new church for the first time can feel like a big step. Here's everything you need to feel at home before you even arrive — no pressure, no surprises, just a warm welcome.
Visit.infoHeading: Everything for a great first visit
Visit.expectBody: A warm welcome at the door, modern worship music, an encouraging message from the Word, and time to connect afterward over coffee.
Visit.durationBody: Each service lasts about 90 minutes — including worship, prayer, and the message. Plenty of time to be filled, never rushed.
Visit.dressBody: Come exactly as you are. You'll see jeans, dresses, sneakers, and everything in between. We care about your heart, not your outfit.
Visit.kidsBody: Bethel Kids offers a safe, fun, and faith-filled environment for children from infants through age 11. Check-in opens 20 minutes before each service.
Visit.languageBody: Spanish service at 9:00 AM and a fully bilingual service at 11:30 AM — whichever you choose, you'll feel right at home.
Visit.parkingBody: Free parking is available on-site at 1000 Foster Rd. Friendly volunteers will be there to help you find a spot.
Visit.checklistHeading: Three simple steps to make Sunday easy
Visit.checklistItem1Body: Give yourself room to park, grab a coffee, and find a seat without feeling rushed.
Visit.checklistItem2Body: Our team will hand you a guest gift and walk you through anything you'd like to know.
Visit.checklistItem3Body: Anyone wearing a Bethel lanyard is there to serve you. No question is too small.
Visit.ctaBody: We'll be saving a seat for you this Sunday. Reach out if you have any questions before you arrive.
